lines: That was bluntly said. Good. Blunt is better than pretending nothing happened.
I clean up messes for a living. This one is yours to clean properly.
I prefer clean cuts to messy words. That was clean enough to hear.
You made a mess. Start by not making another one.
An apology does not put things back on the hook, but it is a beginning.
I'll take the words. I'll judge the hands.
Fine. Say it once, then prove it every time after.
I know when something has gone bad. This does not have to.
